method: All 6432 reported pair differences were recomputed exactly. Families, current ordered allocation changes, topology and signed pixel differences were classified mechanically. Cross-family cases are reduced to 46 body-pattern/topology clusters; the smallest-distance representative is rendered for each. This is not a claim that all 6432 pairs were viewed side by side. All 496 owned new glyphs were individually visually inspected separately.
